question: Who among the following was awarded the Kerala State Kathakali Award in 2012?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalamandalam Vasu Pisharody.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Kalamandalam Vasu Pisharody:**

__
 
• He was **born **in Kerala's **Palakkad **District on January 12, 1943.
 
• He was **awarded the Kerala State Kathakali Award in 2012**.
 
• He was also awarded with the famous **Sangeet Natak Akademi **award in 2003.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma:**

__
 
• She is the **mother of Mohiniyattam **in the form we see it today.
 
• She **played a key role** in popularizing Kerala's unique classical dance form within the Indian classical dance community.
 
• She **dispelled the renowned mystery** behind the name of this dancing style and provided the most compelling, fact-based explanation.
 
• She interpreted Mohiniyattam as a dance performed by a stunning woman than a legendary enchantress from heaven.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__****Kathakali:**

 
• It is a traditional **dance form of Kerala**, India that combines dance, music, and drama.
 
• The **Kerala State Kathakali Award is presented by the Government of Kerala **to recognize the contributions of artists to the field of Kathakali.
